functions.purpose: Target-leading / aim-prediction. Given a target entity, gets its current pos and physics velocity (physical entity status vtable+0x18). If prediction is disabled (turret+0x4ea flag set, or prediction scale turret+0x4cc == 0) it returns the raw target position. When debug level DAT_120286b8+0x8a8==2 it draws a sphere and logs 'Predict %s: speed %.1f (dspeed %.1f), acc %.1f, time %.1f'.

closingSpeed local_2c = dot(velDir, rangeVec) * (1/dist)  (component of target velocity along line of sight)
relSpeed fVar5 = projectileSpeed - closingSpeed; clamp to >= DAT_11de9918 (=1.0)
functions.notes: CGunTurret is a stock CryEngine class but MHO reuses it for auto-firing monsters/turrets; the lead math is genuine aim prediction. turret+0x4cc = prediction strength scalar, turret+0x4ea = prediction-disable bool, DAT_11cc4180 = max target speed used for prediction.
